criteria_verification.notes: Quote-aware chunking verified via independent tests: test_quote_straddling_chunk_boundary_defers_until_close() and test_verifier_called_with_accumulated_not_chunk() both passed. Implementation correctly defers chunk release until quote closes and calls verifier with accumulated text.
Idempotent-prefix guarantee verified via independent test: test_previously_released_chunks_never_altered() passed. Implementation tracks last_released_pos to ensure prefix stability.

Fail-closed policy verified via independent tests: test_verifier_exception_raises_instead_of_yielding() and test_partial_verifier_exception_stops_mid_stream() both passed. Implementation raises RuntimeError instead of yielding unannotated chunks.

Chunk sizing verified via independent tests: test_short_answer_yields_single_chunk(), test_long_answer_breaks_at_sentence_boundaries(), and test_chunk_size_approximately_fifteen_to_twenty_five_words() all passed. Implementation correctly targets 15-25 words per chunk with sentence boundary breaks.

While ruff linting passed, the gitignored file issue prevents proper commit of all changes. A file that cannot be added to git fails the spirit of AC-005 (all modified files must pass checks and be committable).
